signals.brief_en:
Title: sudosubin/agents.nix
Source: Nixpkgs overlay providing AI agent skill definitions sourced from skills.sh and skillsdirectory.com. The overlay aggregates publicly available skill descriptors, normalizes them for Nix packaging, and enables reproducible deployment of AI agents with predefined capabilities. Coverage includes natural language processing, vision, planning, and tool integration. Data is OSINT-derived; completeness and versioning depend on upstream repositories. Users should verify skill relevance and licensing before production use.

العنوان: sudosubin/agents.nix
المصدر: طبقة Nixpkgs تُضيف تعريفات مهارات الوكلاء الذكائيين المستقاة من skills.sh وskillsdirectory.com. تُجمّع الطبقة أوصاف المهارات المتاحة علنًا، وتُطبع لتناسب حزم Nix، مما يتيح نشرًا قابلًا لإعادة الإنتاج لوكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي بقدرات محددة مسبقًا. تشمل النطاقات معالجة اللغة الطبيعية، والرؤية، والتخطيط، وتكامل الأدوات. البيانات مستندة إلى OSINT؛ وتكاملها وإصدارها يعتمد على المستودعات الأصلية. يُنصح المستخدمون بالتحقق من ملاءمة المهارات والترخيص قبل استخدامها في بيئات الإنتاج.

signals.title: @Qtumanalysis: A US SPY AGENCY IS QUIETLY BUILDING A MAP IN ORBIT FOR WHEN GPS GOES DARK QUANTUM IS HOW. In March, a SpaceX rocket carried a small satellit
signals.content: A US SPY AGENCY IS QUIETLY BUILDING A MAP IN ORBIT FOR WHEN GPS GOES DARK QUANTUM IS HOW. In March, a SpaceX rocket carried a small satellite for the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, the US intelligence agency that maps the planet for the military. On board was a diamond quantum magnetometer, built by SBQuantum and Spire. Its job is to measure Earth’s magnetic field from space. That sounds boring until you know what depends on it. NGA maintains the World Magnetic Model, which militaries, aircraft, and the compass in your phone use to work out which way is north. Today that model leans on a European satellite mission that gives periodic snapshots. NGA called this “the first-ever effort to collect reliable geomagnetic data using CubeSat technology,” and the quantum sensor measures continuously. The Pentagon is building navigation that works without GPS by reading Earth’s magnetic field, and it has already flown planes that way. That only works if the magnetic map is accurate. So a spy agency is using quantum sensors to build the map the military will navigate by when GPS goes dark. $INFQ $IONQ $QBTS $RGTI
